leaves.author: body_hitting
leaves.scope: ANY actual finite nonempty primitive row-stochastic real P. Derives positive stationary law and convergence of every original P^n coordinate at ALL natural n; ANY given invariant probability row is the same limit.
proof_review: Actual finite Cesaro exists_invariant produces the stationary probability, not an input field. An actual positive P^k makes every stationary coordinate positive.
One-step TV alpha is bounded in[0,1]; a strictly positive P^k has alpha<1 by exact event-TV. No alpha(P)<1 premise is used.

Geometric contraction at n*k is proved for the same orbit using Q=P^k; k>0 implies n*k tends to infinity. Antitone TV along the original P orbit upgrades subsequence convergence to ALL times. Coordinate errors bounded by2TV yield the actual matrix-power limit.
Uniqueness uses same positive power. primitive_power_tendsto_invariant binds the output to ANY supplied actual invariant row, preventing a choice-based replacement of that law.
leaves.actual_consumer: Same actual Doob H from constructed D; explicit pi=[1/3,2/3] is proved invariant and positive, ANY alternative invariant equals pi, and ALL H^n coordinates converge to THIS pi.
leaves.boundary: Does not apply to merely nonnegative stochastic matrices; identity is nonprimitive. Finite test enumeration is not used as the proof of infinite convergence.

leaves.author: body_hitting
leaves.scope: ANY finite real M, positive R and convergent normalized original powers to arbitrary L. For any nonzero complex eigenvector with eigenvalue a != R, proves norm(a)<R. This theorem does NOT create the power limit.
proof_review: Actual real matrix powers commute with Complex.ofRealHom; a nonzero vector coordinate supplies a nonzero denominator. Normalized powers imply q^n converges for q=a/R.
a != R gives q !=1. Shifted convergence and multiplication imply z=z*q, hence z=0. Mathlib complex power convergence then yields norm(q)<1, with positive R giving norm(a)<R.
No primitive/rank-one hypothesis is needed for this implication, but final primitive KPF factory must derive its hlim from the SAME source, not reintroduce it as an unexplained field.
leaves.actual_consumer: Different actual primitive non-rank-one M=[[2,1],[2,3]]. The caller DERIVES hlim from reviewed actual Doob transport plus Markov mixing before invoking strict_of_power_limit. It proves the ALL complex-eigenpair conditional and consumes actual nonzero subdominant eigenvalue1 with vector[1,-1], not author diagonal/zero-mode example.
leaves.boundary: Intermediate only. Does not by itself establish Perron existence, rank-one limit or algebraic multiplicity1.
